Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-9499

CVE-2023-45935 is scoped to Qt 6 through 6.6 (NULL pointer dereference in QXcbConnection::initializeAllAtoms). The ceph image ships qtbase-opensource-src 5.15.15 (Qt 5), as shown by Qt5 bearer plugins under /usr/lib/*/qt5/. Debian marks this issue unimportant with no security impact and the upstream report is disputed. The Qt 6 XCB code path is not present in the shipped Qt 5 packages.
